I can’t fetch live “latest news” in real time from the web in this chat. My knowledge is current up to **2025-08**, so anything after that I can’t verify unless you paste links/headlines here.

If you want the most current NVIDIA news right now, the fastest reliable places are:

- **NVIDIA Newsroom (press releases):** https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/  
- **NVIDIA Investor Relations (earnings, guidance, filings):** https://investor.nvidia.com/  
- **SEC filings (10-Q/10-K/8-K):** https://www.sec.gov/edgar/browse/?CIK=1045810  
- **Major wire/services:** Reuters, Bloomberg, WSJ, Financial Times (often fastest on market-moving items)
- **Product announcements:** NVIDIA GTC pages + NVIDIA developer blog

If you paste **3–10 recent headlines/links** you’re seeing (or tell me the date range you care about), I can:
- summarize what happened,
- extract key numbers (revenue, guidance, margins, segment mix),
- explain likely market impact and what to watch next.
